Help us make the app better!

When the app crashes, we can send anonymized technical data:
• Device model and Android version
• App version
• Error log (stack trace)

What we DO NOT collect:
• No personal data
• No location or usage data

The data is encrypted and stored on a server in Germany.

For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
